operations.title: Xi has a canonical source-derived indefinite Pick boundary preshape
operations.statement: The theta-defined M=-Xi'/Xi yields a Hermitian Pick kernel. The radical quotient of the formal kernel-vector span is a canonical algebraic indefinite boundary preshape satisfying the Green/Weyl identity. Its form is positive semidefinite iff all Pick matrices are positive, equivalently RH; only after that descent does the compact-resolvent Hilbert operator with det_2=Xi/Xi(0) exist.
operations.scope: Canonical algebraic indefinite boundary and exact positivity gate; no canonical Krein topology, coefficient-Betti comparison map, or positive self-adjoint realization.
